# Pantry Lane — synthetic benchmark

Pantry Lane is a fictional local reference product for testing this toolkit.
Its design uses a warm background, green accents and Fraunces typography.
This is not a production app or a claim about a real service.

- Pantry Lane records pantry items and flags low stock.
- A person can add a low-stock ingredient to a shopping list.
- Marking that shopping item bought moves the pantry item to Restocked.

All names and content are invented. The composition must show an unchecked
destination before adding, then a confirmed shopping item, then restocked.
